sections.value: THIS IS THE LAST WILL of me, {{testatorName}} , a {{testatorOccupation}}, {{testatorAddress}}.

value:
I REVOKE all former Wills and testamentary dispositions made by me.

I APPOINT {{executorName}}, a {{executorOccupation}}, {{executorAddress}} .

And I DECLARE that the expression my executors and trustees shall include {{executorName}} and the survivor of him and any other executors or executors for the time being of the executors of this my will.

1. I GIVE to  .

2. I GIVE the following legacies:

3. I hereby give all other properties, not specifically disposed, by this will or any codicil, including any property over which i may have, power of disposition by will, to all my surviving children in equal shares.

In witness of which I, {{testatorName}} have signed my name this {{date}} .

_______________

Signed by the Testator
